title: Deeper/broader ACadSharp ACDSDATA candidate-branch regression and writer scope
scope: Refresh current ACadSharp ACDS/ACIS pull-request states
Trace the dependency and implementation scope of the candidate ModelerGeometry writer
Refine the peer-screening gate without promoting candidate code to released support

method.kind: Read-only review of GitHub pull-request records and existing local plan/test owners
method.limitations: The PR #1174 regression is a reviewer-reported focused test result, not independently reproduced. No pull-request branch was checked out, and no linked customer or issue attachment was fetched. PR states and commit lists are mutable and were reviewed on 2026-10-19.

sources.revision: open PR record and conversation reviewed 2026-10-19; two commits listed
sources.observed: The open schema/storage refactor introduces CadFileDataStorage and embedded AcdsRecord handling. An Aug 12 reviewer comment reports 10 ACDS tests passing while DxfAcdsDataSectionTests.ReadAcdsDataAttachesAcisPayloadToOwnerEntity fails because readAcdsRecord throws NotImplementedException; the commenter reports post-2013 DXF payload loss on the branch compared with master.

sources.revision: open PR record and commit listing reviewed 2026-10-19; three commits listed
sources.observed: The unreviewed, undeployed ACIS writer PR depends on #1174 and links issue #1195. Its current commit listing includes detailed DwgObjectWriter ModelerGeometry serialization for ACIS data, wireframes, silhouettes, geometry properties, version checks, and warnings for unsupported binary data; this is candidate-source intent, not merged or released support.

The open issue is explicitly against ACadSharp 3.4.9 and reports two interior-design DWGs: 252 3DSOLID entities become zero in DXF in one file, and 51 3DSOLID plus 3 REGION become zero in another, including solid-only block definitions whose INSERTs then render empty. The reporter says LibreDWG census confirmed source entities. Customer drawings are not attached. This is reporter-attributed, version/direction-specific evidence, not an independently reproduced result, current-release behavior, or a libdxfrw reproducer; the issue links candidate PR #1240.
